title: StarVoyager Trailer 2
author: jonhybee
selftext:
Here is the reworked trailer for my upcoming space game (made with AI more on the process below)

Its a space game I made to play spaceship with my kids. I have a Boeing Yoke kit with throttles, pedals and a nice yoke and made a space ship out of cardboard, a carseat and a flatscreen for them but I could not find the right game for them to play spaceship in. Nothing would let me configure the buttons the way I wanted.

Chat GPT (4o back then) managed to sniff the USB devices and rebuild the driver in-game. I then played a few months, graphics where kind of ok but not super. When the nicer models for game graphics came out a few months ago I did one night of graphics rework prompts only and the result was quite amazing to me so I started to think of publishing this game on steam.

Hopefully someone else will enjoy it, its pure freelancer nostagia with a diablo like loot system to feed the loot goblin in me. The lore is loosely based on stuff I learned on r/conspiracy over the years because that seemed funny to me. 

I also spent a bunch of token figuring out a way to lean on royalty free music to make a gta styled in-game radio that is 2 channels in english, one in french and one in spanish. The game is also localized in all three languages (but radio is always the same). I lean heavily on the text to voice dll insie windows (that was also our friend GPT's idea) for the ships AI which is the main character in the game so dont have to re-bake every dialogue everytime I want to change the text of the ship's AI.

All of this was done in VS code with the codex plugin on a GPT basic sub. I used no engine, just pure C++ (I barely know how to read C++ let alone write good code). I dont review any of it, just prompt and test the game. There are over 1000 tests run at every build by now, I noticed later models are a bit heavy handed with the testing but at the same time its amazing to me that they will write a script just to actuate the game's end-points and send a few frames to memory so they can create a png of a screenshot of the game from a terminal to look if things look good after a shader edit for example, that is amazing!

Anyways, I wanted to way thank you for the community, I would not have made it this far with this game without reading all about the news things we can do now with all these new toys. Thank you!

Please let me know what you think? Is it ready for the store? I cant wait to put the free demo up.
